cr_read — DRIVE commonroad op

• Data kinds: any → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.cr_read(source) -> 'dict' (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import drivecommonroad; drivecommonroad.cr_read(source) -> 'dict', registry से लेना हो तो opsdrive.get("cr_read"))

उपयोग

CommonRoad 2020a XML (string या path) पढ़ता है।

रिटर्न मान: {"kind": "commonroad_scene", "id", "dt", "version", "lanelets": {id: {"center" (n,2), "left", "right", "polygon", "successors", "predecessors", "adj_left", "adj_right", "speed_limit_mps" | None, "stop_line" (2,2) | None, "traffic_sign_ids", "traffic_light_ids", "length"}}, "obstacles": [{"id", "type", "static", "shape", "states" (T,5) [time_step, x, y, orientation, velocity]}], "planning_problems": [{"id", "initial": {time_step, x, y, orientation, velocity}, "goal": [{"time_step": (lo, hi), "position_lanelets" | None, "position_polygon" (k,2) | None, "velocity": (lo, hi) | None, "orientation": (lo, hi) | None}]}], "traffic_signs": {id: {"element_ids", "additional", "position"}}, "traffic_lights": {id: {"position", "cycle": [(color, duration)], "time_offset", "active", "direction"}}}।

केंद्र-रेखा बाएँ-दाएँ सीमाओं का औसत है (शीर्षों की संख्या समान होना आवश्यक)। चिह्न 274 का additional_value[0] m/s → float।

Raises ValueError: टूटा हुआ XML, रूट commonRoad नहीं, commonRoadVersion ≠ 2020a, अनिवार्य तत्व अनुपस्थित, आयत के अलावा बाधा।
